name: Pressure Point Training
description:
You are trained in special pressure point techniques. You may spend a half action to make a pressure point attack: Roll Dexterity against an adjacent creature's Defense. On a pass, choose one:

  • The creature takes -1 Defense for 1 round.

  • The creature's speed is reduced by 5 ft for 1 round.

  • The creature takes -1d to all rolls under BODY for 1 round.

  • The creature cannot spend reactions for 1 round.

You may make multiple pressure point attacks each turn, and may choose each effect any number of times. The effects are cumulative.

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Clever Touch
improvements.description: You may spend engagement successes to make pressure point attacks (you still must roll Dexterity against your opponent's Defense for each attack).

improvements.name: Five Touch Attack
improvements.description: If you successfully make five pressure point attacks against the same creature within one round, that creature rolls Injury, checks a Condition, and for the next round, it cannot make attacks that require physical movement and its Speed is reduced to 0.

successes:
